name: intel-cpu-api
description: API endpoints that collect Intel and AMD CPU models and specs from official specification pages.

scripts.upload:amd: npx wrangler r2 object put cpu-specs-data/cpus/amd.json --file=data/cpus/amd.json --remote
scripts.upload:intel: npx wrangler r2 object put cpu-specs-data/cpus/intel.json --file=data/cpus/intel.json --remote
